caption:
When you design mountain biking routes in Costa Rica, you quickly learn that the best lines aren't found on a map. They are found by pushing past where the gravel ends, following the high ridges where the cloud forest meets the sky. I scout every kilometre of our journeys in person, looking for those rare transitions where a rugged farm road becomes a pure flow of green. It is demanding, unpredictable terrain, but it is the only way to build an expedition that feels entirely untouched.
